entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 1.01 +/- 0.05 solar radii from Gomez et al. 2013, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-65 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013A&A...559A..36G/abstract). Mass 0.93 +/- 0.14 solar masses from Gomez et al. 2013, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-65 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2013A&A...559A..36G/abstract). Temperature 5600 +/- 100 K from Gomez et al. 2013, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-65 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,600 K and log g 4.4 (u1 0.498, u2 0.235): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
